requirements.text: • Extensive experience developing software with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
• Hands-on background with .NET, C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, and the .NET Framework.
• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and resolve them effectively.
• Proven capability to work independently and manage responsibilities without close supervision.
• Understanding of full-stack application development across front-end and back-end environments.
• Healthcare industry experience is strongly preferred, especially in settings involving regulated data and compliance considerations.

All applicants applying for U.S. job openings must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Benefits are available to contract/temporary professionals, including medical, vision, dental, and life and disability insurance. Hired contract/temporary professionals are also eligible to enroll in our company 401(k) plan. Visit roberthalf.gobenefits.net for more information.
